gloss: to move up (in time/schedule); to advance; to promote

definitions.gloss: to move up; to advance (a date or time)
definitions.explanation: To reschedule something to happen earlier than originally planned.

definitions.gloss: to promote; to move up (in rank or position)
definitions.explanation: To advance someone to a higher position, often due to a vacancy.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{日程|にってい}を1{週間|しゅうかん}{繰|く}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: We moved up the meeting schedule by one week.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{予報|よほう}なので{運動会|うんどうかい}を{繰|く}り{上|あ}げて{実施|じっし}する。
examples.english: Since rain is forecast, we'll hold the sports day earlier.

examples.japanese: {欠員|けついん}が{出|で}たので{次点|じてん}{候補|こうほ}が{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{当選|とうせん}した。
examples.english: Due to a vacancy, the runner-up was promoted to winner.
examples.notes: {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{当選|とうせん} is a set term for winning by advancement.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる → {繰|く}り{上|あ}げない (negative)
・{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる → {繰|く}り{上|あ}げて (te-form)
・{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる → {繰|く}り{上|あ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {繰|く}る (to reel/wind) + {上|あ}げる (to raise)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{日程|にってい}を{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる - to move up a schedule
・{時間|じかん}を{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる - to advance the time
・{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{当選|とうせん} - winning by advancement
・{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{返済|へんさい} - early repayment

ANTONYM:
{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる - to move down, postpone (the opposite operation)
